svg.title: RC vs NUMA vs UPI boundary comparison across Intel and AMD platforms
svg.desc: Shows that on Intel dual-socket, RC/NUMA/socket boundaries coincide. On AMD EPYC single socket, multiple RCs and NUMA nodes exist within one socket connected by Infinity Fabric, with no UPI involved.
svg.text: RC = NUMA = socket 边界三合一
NIC(RC0) → GPU1(RC1) = 跨 socket = 走 UPI
单 socket 内有多 RC、多 NUMA，无 UPI

g.text: another PCIe root in same NUMA
another PCIe root in same NUMA

svg.text: 跨 RC (RC0→RC2) = 跨 NUMA，走片内 Infinity Fabric，无 UPI，仍在同一 socket
